Name: Void Chicken Retexture
Author: PortalInTime
Description:
Tired of the grumpy-yet-cute looking Void Chickens? Well, look no further, since this mod's got your back!
Void Chickens (and their Baby variety) have been retextured to look a little more tame... [i]And purple![/i]

Along with the Void Chicks/Chickens, this mod also retextures Void Eggs and Void Mayo with purple accents instead of red, and the Void Ghost Pendant now hangs from a purple string instead of that drab old maroon. The texture for the Void Chickens was inspired in part by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1355/?tab=posts]"Better Void Chicken" by vvillow[/url]﻿.

Downloads.Description: Fixed issue where adult chickens weren't displaying updated texture. My bad!
